homepageContent.heroTitle: Tanzania's All-in-One Business & Wholesale Trading Platform
homepageContent.heroSubtitle: POS, FIFO stock control, financial reports and a public storefront marketplace for every Tanzanian business — register your company and start selling today.
homepageContent.overviewTitle: Everything your business needs to run smoothly
homepageContent.overviewText: From the counter to the boardroom, TradeCore gives you one connected command centre.

overviewFeatures.title: POS Sales
overviewFeatures.desc: Fast, offline-capable point-of-sale with multi-store support.

overviewFeatures.title: Stock Control
overviewFeatures.desc: FIFO batch tracking, low-stock alerts and store-wise inventory.

overviewFeatures.title: Financial Reports
overviewFeatures.desc: Real-time revenue, margin, expense and VAT/Tax reporting.

overviewFeatures.title: Executive Copilot
overviewFeatures.desc: AI-driven insights, forecasting and fraud detection.

featureCarousel.title: FIFO Inventory Valuation
featureCarousel.desc: Batch-level first-in, first-out cost tracking so stock valuation and margin stay precise across every store.

featureCarousel.title: POS Shift Reconciliation
featureCarousel.desc: Open/close cashier shifts, match expected vs actual cash and close the day with a full variance audit.

featureCarousel.title: Secure Audit Trails
featureCarousel.desc: Tamper-proof, timestamped logs of every login, sale, transfer and configuration change in the business.

featureCarousel.title: Automated Workflows
featureCarousel.desc: Approvals, reorders, alerts and stock transfers that trigger automatically the moment rules are met.

featureCarousel.title: Team Management
featureCarousel.desc: Roles, permissions and branch/store assignments that keep every user accountable and access tight.

featureCarousel.title: Advanced Analytics
featureCarousel.desc: Revenue, margin, expense and VAT dashboards with drill-downs for executives and branch admins.

featureCarousel.title: Enterprise Security
featureCarousel.desc: Bcrypt password hashing, 256-bit transport encryption and prepared statements on every query.

featureCarousel.title: Multi-Branch Control
featureCarousel.desc: One platform for head office, branches and stores — with per-store stock, prices and reporting.

faqItems.q: How do I register my business?
faqItems.a: Click "Register" at the top of the page, complete the form, choose a plan and submit your payment details. A Super Admin verifies your payment and activates your subscription — you will be notified when you can sign in.

faqItems.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqItems.a: We accept mobile money (Tigo Pesa, M-Pesa, Airtel Money), international bank wire and PayPal. The active pay numbers and account details are shown on the registration page.

faqItems.q: How long does payment verification take?
faqItems.a: Verification is usually completed within a few hours of your submission. Until then your account sits safely in the Pending Verification queue.
Yes. All passwords are hashed with Bcrypt, every database call uses prepared statements, connections are encrypted, and every action is written to a tamper-proof audit trail.

faqItems.q: Can I try TradeCore before paying?
faqItems.a: Absolutely. Use the "Start 1-Day Free Demo" button to explore the full platform with a demo company, store and sample data — no payment required.

faqItems.q: Do you provide training and support?
faqItems.a: Yes. We provide onboarding guidance and responsive support by phone or email. Enterprise customers also get a dedicated account manager.
